intent: Write the test for EventBroadcast (context telemetry-ingestion-processing) at the test file path; the unit under test lives at src/main/java/com/pulsestream/telemetry/eventlog/application/EventBroadcast.java. Assert only against the tabled surface. Backpressure-aware, versioned append-only event stream port to downstream analytics. The consumer is out of process (boundary declared in the execution strategy). publish returns true when the record was accepted into the bounded stream (on_true: broadcast succeeded) and false when it was refused because the bounded buffer is full or the sink rejected it (on_false: record dropped from the broadcast only; the caller counts telemetry.pipeline.dropped stage=broadcast). stream exposes the broadcast Flux. TEST DUTIES: Interface only: assert the tabled methods exist.

methods.semantics: true accepted; false refused (overflow) and counted by the caller in telemetry.pipeline.dropped{stage=broadcast}
